JSON.Description: Managed Microsoft Edge baseline for Android Enterprise devices. Requests Edge as the default browser, applies a locked focused new-tab layout, removes first-run, Copilot, My Apps and personalisation prompts, and enforces HTTPS, SmartScreen, PUA protection and device authentication before password autofill. Android can still require a one-time user confirmation before changing the system default browser.
